# Value Watch 3.0 / Cardano — coding instructions

- Work on a feature branch, not `main`. Do not merge or deploy without explicit project-owner approval.
- This is a research-only multi-sport platform (football, horse racing, tennis, NFL). Preserve the four existing paper-slip approaches and all saved data.
- Never relax the engine's `UNVALIDATED` model status or `BLOCKED` betting-publication gate without independently reviewed validation evidence and explicit approval.
- Do not invent live odds, positive expected value, agent activity, race-video analysis, machine-learning outputs, source data, or test results.
- Existing race-video lab is manual annotation, not automated visual recognition. Floating Cardano lab is a read-only development monitor, not an autonomous agent service.
- Research allocation is Applied 40%, Experimental 35%, Frontier Discovery 25%; speculative experiments remain paper-only.
- Implement minimal changes with tests and negative cases; inspect the complete affected workflow, persistence, compatibility and regression risks.
- Report which tests actually ran and any unverified assumptions. Never claim browser tests passed without execution evidence.
- Prefer self-contained code, safe input handling, accessible controls, and no secrets in source or logs.
- Check `README.md`, `paper-lab/README.md`, and relevant tests before changes. Existing production site must remain unchanged during development.
